source_kind: Fraunhofer FDK AAC source distributed by Android upstream;implementation evidence,not normative ISO text
finding: When SBR headers are present,integer downscale ratio is checked;odd ratios other than1 are rejected. Unsupported even factors beyond2/4 are not applied by this reference. Frame length must divide the selected ratio.
fvid_scope: FVid supports factor3 short ELD without SBR. Its standalone public SBR rate negotiation already refuses factor3;native MPS also refuses it explicitly. Do not list factor3 SBR as an established valid missing profile merely because plain ELD supports factor3.
normative_qualification: Full relevant ISO text is not available;this audit does not prove a universal normative prohibition of every hypothetical rational bank.
next_action: Retain explicit refusal;investigate documented admissible tools and SSC adaptation instead of inventing fractional CLDFB behavior.
